primitive.relation: two presentations of chordality, kept as two distinct public contracts of GTBase.chordal with no claimed equivalence (no chordal / clique-tree / perfect-elimination characterization exists in the pinned GraphTheory or MathComp sources, and none is assumed). Cycle presentation: GTBase.chordal.chordal_by_cycles G (every chordless genuine cycle, GTBase.induced_cycles.chordless_cycle, has at most three vertices; equivalently no hole, chordal_by_cyclesP) is Packing.XE1.xe1_chordal by conversion (its xe1_induced_cycle is B23's alias of chordless_cycle). Clique-tree presentation: GTBase.chordal.admits_clique_tree G (some supplied index graph T and bag map form a clique_tree_decomposition: tree_bag_decomposition, i.e. is_tree [set: T] with vertex and edge coverage and connected fibres, plus cliqueb bags) is GTMisc.X169.x169_chordal by conversion (x169_clique_tree unfolds to exactly that body and stays X169's local support, like x169_clique_tree_degree_at_most and x169_tree_decomposition). The empty index is a tree, bags may be empty, unused or repeated, the host need not be connected, bags need not be maximal cliques, and a nonempty host forces an inhabited index. No guard enters either source. The directed Digraph.chi_bounded.chordal_C3 (oriented, no transitive triangle, no long directed induced cycle) is a different contract and stays untouched.

chordless-cycle-bound.note: public contract GTBase.chordal.chordal_by_cycles: every chordless genuine cycle (B23's chordless_cycle, 2 < size c) has at most three vertices, equivalently no hole; Erdos #81 is frozen over it, keeping the unrelated M1 clique edge-partition vocabulary live.

clique-tree-existence.note: public contract GTBase.chordal.admits_clique_tree: some supplied tree-indexed bag decomposition (C13's tree_bag_decomposition) has clique bags; not identified with the cycle contract. X169's blocked token-sliding row and its polytime chain are frozen over it; the documented intermediate-stability defect and the disproved status are kept.

upstream_audit.note: No chordal, clique-tree, perfect-elimination or simplicial-vertex characterization in the pinned GraphTheory / MathComp sources. GraphTheory.treewidth supplies sdecomp on a supplied forest and decomp_clique (a NONEMPTY clique lies in a bag), used through C13's same-forest bridge bag_decomposition_sdecompP with the explicit tree condition kept (clique_tree_decomposition_sdecompP, clique_tree_decomposition_clique); sgraph supplies clique / cliqueb / cliqueP; minor.Kn_clique is used by the client. Neither presentation is derived from the other.
